notes: Major code SE28 (CS). Same core as SE27; the Civil Structures focus sequence appears on the diploma. Minimum 145 units plus college GE. Verified against catalog.

buckets.label: Introductory Structural Engineering
buckets.note: SE 1, SE 3, SE 9 all confirmed on both catalog and department pages.

buckets.label: Technical electives
buckets.note: 3 preapproved technical electives outside the focus sequence; SE 195/197/198 not allowed.

buckets.label: General education
buckets.note: Minimum 24 units plus college GE. Engineering-major GE bucket. The note says 'Minimum 24 units plus college GE.' At UCSD, general education / humanities & social science requirements are defined by the student's college (Revelle, Muir, Marshall, Warren, Roosevelt, Sixth, Seventh, Eighth), not by the SE department. The specific qualifying courses depend on which college the student belongs to, so this is satisfied via the college's own GE section rather than a fixed course list in the major.

buckets.label: Total program units
buckets.note: Minimum 145 units. Pure minimum unit count for the major: 145 units minimum (per program note and file notes). No course list; satisfied by accumulating the required total across all major + GE coursework.
